claims.statement: Confirmed BOS and external CHoCH require a candle-body close beyond the exact broken swing or protected point; wick-only penetration is not a confirmed structural break.
Internal structure is lower-order timing evidence and cannot independently reverse parent external structure.
A protected point must be linked to the origin swing of a move that produced a qualified structural break; an arbitrary recent high or low is insufficient.

The source set conflicts on displacement: one manual treats it as a quality attribute for BOS/CHoCH existence, while house doctrine and consensus research sometimes make it mandatory for a valid or actionable break.
An FVG is an imbalance and must not be relabeled as an order block; POI kind and lifecycle must remain explicit.
A shallow POI may be inducement in front of a deeper origin OB, but automatic deeper-OB priority is a project hypothesis that still requires case evidence and cannot be universal doctrine.
Insufficient left context or unclear hierarchy requires explicit abstention rather than forced BOS/CHoCH classification.

unresolved_conflicts: Whether displacement is required for the existence of BOS/CHoCH or only for quality/actionability.
Whether deeper origin OB priority should be a default ranking rule or only a contextual hypothesis.
recommendations: Separate structural existence from structural quality/actionability in the constitution.
Require exact broken-object IDs and confirmation-candle IDs for every structural event.
Keep deeper-OB preference contested until independent cases support it.
